_comment: Challenge de validation en mode scénario, adossé à un challenge `code`, avec MyCoach (MyKine) déjà déployé comme cible. En mode scénario il n'y a ni quorum ni résolution : chaque walkthrough complétée paie, d'où `required_validations: null`.

validation_challenge.title: Usage walkthrough — MyCoach
validation_challenge.description: Walk the same usage scenario across every application delivered on the source challenge, step by step, and close on an overall verdict.

_scenario_comment: Le scénario suit le parcours réel de l'application — six écrans plus le profil. Volontairement pas d'étape « créer un compte » : la démo n'a pas de backend, tout est local au navigateur. L'étape 3 décide du reste : MyCoach a besoin de la caméra, et une iframe multi-origine n'y a pas droit tant que la page hôte ne la délègue pas.

scenario_steps.title: Open the home screen and read today's session
scenario_steps.instructions: Note whether the proposed session makes sense without explanation: can you tell what you are meant to do, how long it takes, and where you stand in the week?

scenario_steps.title: Open the exercise list
scenario_steps.instructions: Prescribed exercises must be distinguishable from the library. Check that tapping a row starts the exercise directly, with no intermediate screen.

scenario_steps.title: Start an exercise and grant camera access
scenario_steps.instructions: If the application is embedded in the left-hand frame and the camera is denied without even asking, mark this step « Blocked », open the application in a tab using the button provided, and carry on there. A camera that still fails to start once in a tab is a genuine validation result — mark it « Failed ».

scenario_steps.title: Complete a full set
scenario_steps.instructions: The skeleton must track the movement, the repetition count must advance, and the measurements must appear as an overlay. Report any count that skips or gets stuck.

scenario_steps.title: Read the end-of-session summary
scenario_steps.instructions: The summary aggregates every set of the exercise. Check that the per-repetition range of motion is legible and that units are present — a measurement without a unit is unusable.

scenario_steps.title: Open the replay and scrub the timeline
scenario_steps.instructions: Drag the timeline, switch between the 2D and 3D skeletons, and check that the repetition markers land in the right place against the angle curve.

scenario_steps.title: Find the session in the history
scenario_steps.instructions: The session you just completed must appear, grouped by day, with its totals, and the replay must be reachable from there. Reload the page before checking: the data is local to the browser.
